scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction worker who continuously deposits contributions
Parents' total annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000
Applicants already working in government services are ineligible for benefits
Applicant must have passed the preliminary competitive examination for Indian Administrative Service or Rajasthan Administrative Service
No benefit is payable for examinations of states other than Rajasthan
Incentive amount is given only once per examination; if already received for a particular exam, no further incentive will be paid for that exam
If any false information is provided, the beneficiary must repay the entire assistance amount with interest
benefits_summary: ₹1,00,000 incentive for passing the IAS preliminary exam and ₹50,000 incentive for passing the RAS preliminary exam
